limits: For white wine, Chardonnay: at least 60%
For rosé wine, Meunier: at least 60%
rules.yield_base: 55 hl/ha for white, 50 for red, 50 for rosé

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Loire Valley appellation around the city of Orléans, making wine from Chardonnay, Meunier and Pinot Noir. Pinot Gris is allowed as a minor grape.
